plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Correctional Administration map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. The inventoried program 'Correctional Administration' is listed in the mapper under the name 'Correctional Administration'; the program details state the student will be awarded an Associate of Arts degree. This plan transcribes the program's 'to Degree' pathway, 'Correctional Administration / Associate of Arts / 60-61.5 units / 4 terms / to Degree', in full. The program's second 2026-2027 pathway ('to CSU', also 60-61.5 units, 4 terms) is a different, CalGETC-based map and is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 the program page states verbatim: 'We don't have detailed information about different pathways or courses for this program.' — the 2026-2027 map transcribed here is the only detailed map for this program. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15 / 15 / 15. The only ranged row is Term 1 '1.A. English Communication (BC)' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. CRIM B50's title is printed 'Criminal Justice Report Writng' in both views of the 2026-2027 map and is transcribed exactly as printed. The 'BC Elective' slot is printed three times in Term 4 (3, 3 and 2 units) and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each occurrence exactly as printed. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Correctional Administration exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
